notes.title: Playtest - Stability Improvements
notes.content:
Stability & Save System Update
Build playtest-57789

Release Notes:
- Save System – Adjusted save timing to prevent flow-breaking issues, especially after crashes.
- Crash Fix – Resolved crash when ending a mission with enemies still present on the map.
- Crash Fix – Fixed crash when returning to Main Menu during the Crater Boss fight.
- Softlock Fix – Fixed elevator softlock triggered by dying before an activity starts due to the “Overheat Drain” perk (reported by Bismuth).
- Perk Update – Reworked mutated perk “Overheat Drain” into a new version: “Watch them BURN!”
- Crash Fix – Addressed crash caused by spam-clicking at the end of a dialogue (reported by Bismuth).
- UI Update – Changed Collection objective text from “Eggs Found” to “Golden Eggs Found” in both the Activity Result and Selection screens.

notes.title: Playtest Update Notes for Feb 28
notes.content:
- Fixed save game files issues, players should now be able to keep their progress.
- Fixed flowbreaker issu where holes in the floor near the elevator (HUB) would cause the player to stay stuck in a fall animation.
- Fixed flowbreaker issue with navmesh inside the first level that would cause enemies to jump down the map and out of sight.
